title: Newsletters
content: Newsletters Keeping our community informed RDA Newsletters The RDA is guided by principles of Openness and Inclusivity. We therefore value transparent communication with our members and send them regular updates to our community through the form of newsletters. As well as notifying our community on important updates regarding the work of the RDA, we send a regular ‘Month in Review’ newsletter filled with RDA activities and relevant news from our community and the wider open research network. Take a look at past newsletter issues below. For newsletters before 2023, see the archived site. Would you like to receive our monthly newsletter, directly to your inbox? Become an RDA Member free of charge to be automatically added to our mailing list for community updates.
